body.name: support_face_handle
body.def: Start from the positive support of each \(K_{s,x,u,w}\) and the range of its marginal tangent map \(\mathscr L_{s,x,u,w}\), solve the coupled observed-cell equations without dividing by zero entries of \(C_x\), compute the resulting feasible two-sided tangent cone of the observed-law fiber, and dualize it by finite-dimensional Farkas separation.
